# multitask.clean.execute_clean { #spotforecast2_safe.multitask.clean.execute_clean }

```python
multitask.clean.execute_clean(task, cache_home=None, dry_run=False)
```

Remove all cached data from the pipeline cache directory.

Deletes the entire target directory (models, tuning results, and any
other artefacts).  When the directory does not exist the function
returns without error.  When ``dry_run`` is ``True`` nothing is
removed but details of what would be deleted are logged and returned.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name       | Type                                                     | Description                                                                                                          | Default    |
|------------|----------------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| task       | [BaseTask](`spotforecast2_safe.multitask.base.BaseTask`) | A ``BaseTask`` (or subclass) instance.  Used to resolve the default cache directory when ``cache_home`` is ``None``. | _required_ |
| cache_home | [Optional](`typing.Optional`)\[[Path](`pathlib.Path`)\]  | Override the directory to clean.  ``None`` uses ``get_cache_home(task.config.cache_home)``.                          | `None`     |
| dry_run    | [bool](`bool`)                                           | If ``True``, report what would be deleted without actually removing anything.                                        | `False`    |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                                       | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
|--------|------------------------------------------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [Dict](`typing.Dict`)\[[str](`str`), [Any](`typing.Any`)\] | Dict with keys: status: ``"success"`` after successful removal, ``"dry_run"``     when ``dry_run`` is ``True``, or ``"empty"`` when the     directory did not exist. cache_dir: The Path of the directory targeted for cleaning. deleted_items: Sorted list of top-level item names that were     (or would have been) removed. |

## Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                           | Description                                                                                         |
|--------|--------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [RuntimeError](`RuntimeError`) | If the directory exists but cannot be removed due to a permissions error or other OS-level failure. |

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```{python}
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path
from spotforecast2_safe.multitask import CleanTask
from spotforecast2_safe.multitask.clean import execute_clean
from spotforecast2_safe.configurator.config_multi import ConfigMulti

with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
    cache = Path(tmp) / "sf2_cache"
    cache.mkdir()
    (cache / "models").mkdir()
    (cache / "tuning_results").mkdir()
    cfg = ConfigMulti(cache_home=cache)
    task = CleanTask(cfg)
    result = execute_clean(task, dry_run=True)
    print(result["status"])
    print(sorted(result["deleted_items"]))
```
